methodology: 10 target circuits (Bell, GHZ, VQE-like, Grover, QFT, teleportation). Each prompt is a fresh chat completion, expert=quantum, temperature 0.2, max_tokens 600, generation model: D:\Gen AI Applications\project\models\gemma-3-1b-it-Q4_K_M.gguf. anchored=True: with --anchored, a reference circuit pre-validated by Qiskit is injected as a one-shot in-context example; the model must adapt it (structure-copying). DeepSeek-R1 1.5B burns its budget on a reasoning preamble before emitting code, while gemma-3-1b emits correct headers but hallucinates an invalid body (e.g. 'q[0] = h;', for-loops), so raw small-model body generation is inherently weak. Raw output is run through the post-processing guard (sanitize_qasm: fenced-block extraction, pseudo-op translation, header/qreg/creg injection) then the strict Qiskit validator (validate_llm_qasm). PASS = valid AND contains required gates AND qubit count >= target. trials=3: PASS for a circuit requires >= 2 of 3 independent generations. Target >= 90%.
